about: arXiv.org, the open-access preprint archive. This CLI browses category listings (new, recent, monthly), daily catch-up, archive overviews, yearly stats, the category taxonomy and RSS feeds, and fetches paper abstract pages and BibTeX citations.

commands.summary: List papers from the last 5 announcement days in an arXiv category or archive (e.g. cs.LG, math.NT, cs), paged. Results alternate: an {id,url} item, then that paper's {title,authors,subjects,comments}

params.name: category
params.description: Category or archive id, e.g. cs.LG, math.NT, astro-ph, cs

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip (offset)

params.name: show
params.description: Entries per page

commands.summary: List the latest announcement (new submissions, cross-lists, replacements) in a category, with abstracts. Results alternate: an {id,url} item, then that paper's {title,authors,subjects,abstract} item.

params.name: category
params.description: Category or archive id, e.g. cs.LG, math.NT, cs

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip (offset)

params.name: show
params.description: Entries per page (site default 2000)

commands.summary: List all papers in a category or archive for a given month (YYYY-MM) or year (YYYY), paged. Results alternate: an {id,url} item, then that paper's {title,authors,subjects,comments} item.

params.name: category
params.description: Category or archive id, e.g. cs.LG, cs, math

params.name: month
params.description: Month as YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-10), or a year as YYYY

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip (offset)

params.name: show
params.description: Entries per page

commands.summary: Show everything announced in an archive on a given day (new, cross-lists, replacements). Use for catching up since a date. Results alternate: an {id,url} item, then that paper's {title,authors,subject

params.name: archive
params.description: Archive id, e.g. cs, math, astro-ph

params.name: date
params.description: Day as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be a recent date.

params.name: abs
params.description: Include abstracts

params.name: page
params.description: Page counter the site adds when following 'Continue to the next day' links

commands.summary: Get a paper's abstract page: title, authors, abstract, comments, subjects, submission history and PDF/HTML links

params.name: id
params.description: arXiv id, optionally with a version suffix, e.g. 2610.21832 or 2610.22339v1

commands.summary: Export the BibTeX citation for a paper

params.name: id
params.description: arXiv id, e.g. 2610.21832

commands.summary: Get the raw RSS 2.0 XML feed of the latest announcement in a category: items with title, link, description, dc:creator, category and arxiv:announce_type. Empty on weekends and holidays.

params.name: category
params.description: Category or archive id; join several with '+', e.g. cs.LG or cs.LG+stat.ML

commands.summary: Get an archive overview (e.g. cs, math, physics): its subject categories with descriptions and browse links

params.name: archive
params.description: Archive id, e.g. cs, math, astro-ph, cond-mat, q-bio, stat, eess, econ

commands.summary: Get monthly article counts for an archive in a given year

params.name: archive
params.description: Archive id, e.g. cs, math

params.name: year
params.description: Four-digit year, e.g. 2025

commands.summary: List the full arXiv category taxonomy (category ids, names and descriptions across all groups)
